headline: Sensex and Nifty open higher as Trent zooms 5% on strong earnings; global tech selloff and oil prices weigh

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Trent reported a 25% increase in net profit despite cost pressures and stiff competition
Investors are awaiting Q2 results from major firms including Reliance Industries and Sun Pharma
Global markets are facing a selloff in tech shares, triggered by slowing online business at Amazon
Crude oil prices have surged to $118, creating pressure on the overall market outlook
whatHappening: The Sensex and Nifty 50 opened higher today, defying earlier negative signals from the GIFT Nifty
Trent shares jumped 5% in early trade following its positive quarterly earnings report
Punjab National Bank settled three fraud claims worth Rs 43 lakh at its Greater Noida branch
Asian markets tumbled tracking a selloff in US tech stocks and concerns over a Binance hack
summary: The Indian stock market opened on a positive note today, led by a 5% surge in Trent following its strong 25% profit growth. While domestic sentiment is supported by upcoming Q2 results from Reliance and Sun Pharma, global headwinds like the tech selloff and $118 oil prices persist. PNB also remained in focus after settling fraud-related claims in its Greater Noida branch.
